purpose: Criteria-driven investigation development; no fixed model-answer gold and no superiority claim
review_requirements: Freeze the code, definitions, corpus, runtime requests, source access, and budgets for each comparison.
Judge source support, uncertainty, and decision usefulness; answer length or tool count alone is not success.
An independent chemist must establish source interpretation and assess scientific correctness.
Keep these cases out of any subsequently designated untouched evaluation set.

cases.question: Investigate how to prepare CCOC(=O)N1CC[C@H](NC(=O)c2cc(Cl)c(N)cc2OC)[C@H](OC)C1. Inspect EP0076530A2, including Example LXVIII if available, and determine precisely what it supports about the requested stereoisomer.
criteria: Record graph-derived target identity and stereochemistry without equating atom indices to chemical locants.
Distinguish connectivity, relative stereochemistry, racemate/single-enantiomer claims, and absolute configuration using inspected evidence.
Label any transfer from a differently specified starting material or product as an adaptation rather than a reported exact-target result.
Preserve uncertainty where structure drawings or the relevant example could not be inspected.
disqualifying_behaviors: Treat matching mass or connectivity as proof of the requested absolute configuration.
Describe an uninspected patent example as verified.

cases.question: Find evidence for making O=C(O)c1ccc2nc(-c3cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c3)oc2c1. Compare reported conditions with any adaptations you propose, and identify missing operations before claiming the target is reached.
criteria: Attribute each reported condition and yield to a specific inspected example or corpus observation.
Keep proposed solvent, temperature, equivalents, work-up, and yield separate from reported values.
Check whether the terminal structure is the requested free acid or a precursor such as an ester.
Explain structural transfer assumptions and missing experimental support without filling gaps from memory.
disqualifying_behaviors: Invent an operating value or present a scaled/proposed value as an experimental report.
Present a route ending at a different terminal structure as complete.

cases.question: Assess the proposed transformation CC=O.N>>CCN. If local tools leave the chemistry unresolved, explain what remains unknown and what evidence would help, without calling it either impossible or experimentally demonstrated.
criteria: Preserve the actual canonical status, warnings, mapping/completeness limitations, and not-run checks.
Distinguish observed graph transformation from proposed reaction conditions and unreported selectivity.
Treat missing local coverage as a limitation of evidence, not a universal impossibility result.
Identify a useful next investigation without inventing a precedent or silently changing the scientific rules.
disqualifying_behaviors: Treat successful execution or operator reconstruction as proof of experimental feasibility.
Change a failed or unknown check into a passed scientific claim.

cases.question: Investigate a synthesis lead for CCOC(=O)N1CC[C@H](NC(=O)c2cc(Cl)c(N)cc2OC)[C@H](OC)C1 under the supplied unavailable-source scenario. Explain what can still be established and what cannot.
cases.evaluation_setup: Use a development fixture or recorded run with a genuine failed fetch, empty/scanned extraction, or unavailable search. Keep failure evidence intact; do not deliberately overload a public source.
criteria: Save and disclose retrieval/extraction failure with its actual status.
Separate local structure calculations and remembered leads from inspected external evidence.
Use bounded recovery attempts and preserve a useful partial answer.
Do not relabel model-supplied prose as a fetched source or an exact excerpt.
disqualifying_behaviors: Invent a passage, source locator, or successful retrieval to complete the response schema.

cases.question: Compare the supplied source records for this reaction. Identify duplicate observations, independently supported claims, and unresolved disagreements in quantities, yield, or stereochemical scope before recommending a next investigation.
cases.evaluation_setup: Provide explicit development source fixtures containing two records derived from the same publication/example and at least one conflicting claim with traceable provenance. These are synthetic review fixtures, not new experimental observations.
criteria: Retain separate source records and identify shared publication/example provenance.
Do not count repeated database rows or copied patent text as independent experimental support.
Locate the conflicting claims and distinguish transcription ambiguity, scope differences, and unresolved contradictions.
Cite the conflicting evidence and abstain from selecting a supposedly verified winner without adequate support.
disqualifying_behaviors: Merge conflicting conditions or stereochemical claims into one apparently reported procedure.
Use duplicated observation count as proof of independently replicated success.
